notes: Source = Engrossed in House (EH) text (10,952 chars, fully read), the version that passed the House. No referencedSources registered. MATERIAL FINDING (3 rows, one underlying error): the brief ('through fiscal year 2031 at $10M per year') and gaps[0] ('The bill authorizes $10M a year') describe the SUPERSEDED introduced version's funding — the engrossed text struck the entire funding section, contains no dollar figure and no 'fiscal'/'2031' anywhere (grep-confirmed), and replaces the funding-year scheme with a 7-year-after-enactment sunset (Section 406). The analysis's own versionChanges.removed field documents this drop, so the analysis is internally contradictory. Everything else (14-member commission, county/tribal/state seats, advisory/no-regulations, 7-year sunset, title IV of PL 105-384) verifies verbatim. 3 minor omissions (NOAA liaison, cooperative-agreement/financial-assistance authority, quarterly meetings). likelihoodReason sponsor/cosponsor/calendar facts verify against cache metadata, not bill text.
